framework.name: SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria)
framework.description: Attestation report on controls relevant to security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality and privacy. Security (Common Criteria) is always in scope. Availability and Confidentiality are included by default; Processing Integrity and Privacy apply when you add them to your report scope (set this in your company profile).

requirements.title: Integrity and ethical values
requirements.guidance: Leadership sets the tone with a code of conduct that staff acknowledge.

requirements.title: Independent oversight
requirements.guidance: The board or equivalent oversees internal control independently of management.

requirements.title: Structure, reporting lines and authority
requirements.guidance: Management defines org structure, reporting lines and responsibilities.

requirements.title: Commitment to competence
requirements.guidance: Attract, develop and retain competent people through hiring checks and training.

requirements.title: Accountability
requirements.guidance: People are held accountable for their internal control responsibilities.

requirements.title: Relevant, quality information
requirements.guidance: Generate and use quality information to support internal control.

controls.title: Security metrics and monitoring of the programme

requirements.title: Internal communication
requirements.guidance: Communicate security objectives and responsibilities internally, including how to report concerns.

requirements.title: External communication
requirements.guidance: Communicate commitments and relevant matters to customers, vendors and regulators.

requirements.title: Clear objectives
requirements.guidance: Specify objectives clearly enough to identify related risks.

requirements.title: Risk identification and analysis
requirements.guidance: Identify and analyse risks to objectives, including vendor and technology risks.

requirements.title: Fraud risk
requirements.guidance: Consider the potential for fraud when assessing risks.

requirements.title: Significant changes
requirements.guidance: Identify and assess changes that could affect internal control.

controls.title: Security in projects and change initiatives

requirements.title: Ongoing and separate evaluations
requirements.guidance: Evaluate whether controls are present and functioning, for example internal audits and pen tests.

controls.title: Security metrics and monitoring of the programme

requirements.title: Communicating deficiencies
requirements.guidance: Report control deficiencies to those responsible for corrective action in time.

requirements.title: Control activities mitigate risks
requirements.guidance: Select and develop controls that reduce risks to acceptable levels.

controls.title: Risk treatment and Statement of Applicability

requirements.title: General controls over technology
requirements.guidance: Select and develop general IT controls.

requirements.title: Policies and procedures
requirements.guidance: Deploy controls through policies and the procedures that put them into action.

requirements.title: Logical access security
requirements.guidance: Implement access security software, infrastructure and architecture to protect information assets.

controls.title: Encryption at rest and key management

requirements.title: User registration and authorisation
requirements.guidance: Register and authorise users before issuing credentials, and remove access when no longer needed.

controls.title: Joiner, mover and leaver access process

requirements.title: Role-based access changes
requirements.guidance: Authorise, modify and remove access based on roles and least privilege.

controls.title: Joiner, mover and leaver access process

requirements.title: Physical access
requirements.guidance: Restrict physical access to facilities and protected assets.

requirements.title: Disposal of assets
requirements.guidance: Remove data from assets before disposal or re-use.

requirements.title: Boundary protection
requirements.guidance: Protect against threats from sources outside system boundaries.

requirements.title: Data transmission and movement
requirements.guidance: Restrict and protect transmission, movement and removal of information.

requirements.title: Unauthorised and malicious software
requirements.guidance: Prevent or detect unauthorised or malicious software.

requirements.title: Configuration and vulnerability detection
requirements.guidance: Detect configuration changes and new vulnerabilities.

requirements.title: Anomaly monitoring
requirements.guidance: Monitor system components for anomalies that indicate malicious acts or errors.

controls.title: Centralised logging with retention in India

requirements.title: Security event evaluation
requirements.guidance: Evaluate security events to decide whether they are incidents.

requirements.title: Incident response
requirements.guidance: Respond to incidents with a defined programme to contain, remediate and communicate.

requirements.title: Incident recovery
requirements.guidance: Recover from incidents and apply lessons learned.

requirements.title: Change management
requirements.guidance: Authorise, design, test, approve and implement changes to infrastructure, data and software.

requirements.title: Business disruption
requirements.guidance: Identify and mitigate risks from potential business disruptions.

requirements.title: Vendor and partner risk
requirements.guidance: Assess and manage risks from vendors and business partners.

controls.title: Vendor contracts and data processing agreements

requirements.title: Capacity management
requirements.guidance: Monitor and manage capacity to meet availability commitments.

requirements.title: Environmental protection, backup and recovery infrastructure
requirements.guidance: Protect infrastructure and maintain backups and recovery capability.

requirements.title: Recovery plan testing
requirements.guidance: Test recovery plan procedures periodically.

requirements.title: Identify and protect confidential information
requirements.guidance: Identify and maintain confidential information to meet confidentiality objectives.

controls.title: Encryption at rest and key management

requirements.title: Dispose of confidential information
requirements.guidance: Dispose of confidential information when no longer needed.

requirements.title: Processing specifications and data definitions
requirements.guidance: Define and communicate what correct processing means: data definitions, product specifications and service commitments.

requirements.title: Complete and accurate inputs
requirements.guidance: Validate system inputs so that only complete, accurate and authorised data enters processing.

requirements.title: Complete, accurate and timely processing
requirements.guidance: Process data completely, accurately and on time, with errors detected and corrected (reconciliations, exception queues).

requirements.title: Complete and accurate outputs
requirements.guidance: Deliver outputs only to intended recipients, complete and accurate, and check them before release where it matters.

requirements.title: Stored inputs, in-process items and outputs
requirements.guidance: Store inputs, items in processing and outputs completely and accurately, protected from unauthorised change.

requirements.title: Privacy notice
requirements.guidance: Give data subjects notice of your privacy practices: what you collect, why, how long you keep it and their choices.

requirements.title: Choice and consent
requirements.guidance: Tell people their choices about collection, use, retention, disclosure and disposal, and obtain consent where required.

requirements.title: Collection limited to the stated purpose
requirements.guidance: Collect personal information only for the purposes in your notice.

controls.title: Privacy by design and organisational measures

requirements.title: Explicit consent for sensitive collection
requirements.guidance: Obtain explicit consent where it is required, and document it.

requirements.title: Use limited to the stated purpose
requirements.guidance: Use personal information only for the purposes in your notice.

controls.title: Privacy by design and organisational measures

requirements.title: Retention
requirements.guidance: Keep personal information only as long as needed for the stated purposes.

requirements.title: Secure disposal
requirements.guidance: Dispose of personal information securely when it is no longer needed.

requirements.title: Access by data subjects
requirements.guidance: Let people see and get a copy of the personal information you hold about them.

controls.title: Data principal rights and grievance handling

requirements.title: Correction
requirements.guidance: Correct or annotate personal information when people show it is wrong, and tell third parties where needed.

controls.title: Data principal rights and grievance handling

requirements.title: Disclosure to third parties
requirements.guidance: Disclose personal information to third parties only for notified purposes and with consent where required.

controls.title: Vendor contracts and data processing agreements

requirements.title: Record of authorised disclosures
requirements.guidance: Keep a complete and accurate record of authorised disclosures.

requirements.title: Record of unauthorised disclosures
requirements.guidance: Record detected or reported unauthorised disclosures, including breaches.

requirements.title: Third-party privacy commitments
requirements.guidance: Obtain privacy commitments from vendors and other third parties and check they meet them.

controls.title: Vendor contracts and data processing agreements

requirements.title: Third parties report unauthorised disclosures
requirements.guidance: Require vendors to notify you of unauthorised disclosures and act on their notices.

controls.title: Vendor contracts and data processing agreements

requirements.title: Breach notification to data subjects
requirements.guidance: Notify affected people of breaches and incidents to meet your commitments and the law.

requirements.title: Accounting of disclosures
requirements.guidance: On request, tell people which third parties received their personal information.

controls.title: Data principal rights and grievance handling

requirements.title: Data quality
requirements.guidance: Keep personal information accurate, complete and relevant for its purposes.

requirements.title: Inquiries, complaints and disputes
requirements.guidance: Handle privacy questions, complaints and disputes through a defined process and fix issues found.

controls.title: Data principal rights and grievance handling
